about.title: Tungkol sa The Freak Circus
about.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the game and this site.
about.gameP1: The Freak Circus is a dark psychological horror visual novel developed by the independent creator Garula (Neko Bueno). It is published on itch.io and has accumulated a dedicated international fanbase through word-of-mouth across platforms including TikTok, Tumblr, and Reddit.
about.gameP2: The game follows an unnamed protagonist who visits a mysterious, isolated circus and becomes entangled with five dangerous performers. The narrative unfolds across multiple days, with player choices determining character routes and endings.
about.siteP1: thefreakcircus.help is an unofficial fan resource offering the game embed, character guides, walkthroughs, and articles. We embed the game via the official CDN and do not host, redistribute, or modify any game files.
about.siteP2: To support the developer directly, visit the official itch.io page.

characters.title: Characters of The Freak Circus
characters.subtitle: Five extraordinary performers. Five routes. One fate.

list.name: Pierrot
list.description: Controlled, melancholic, and intensely perceptive. Pierrot is the emotional anchor of the circus, performing sorrow for crowds who laugh at his tears. His route is the most psychologically demanding and offers the most lore about the circus's true nature.
list.routeTip: Choose introspective and empathetic dialogue in Day 1. Avoid defiance in Day 2 to unlock the Good Ending.

list.name: Harlequin
list.description: Unpredictable and theatrical, Harlequin masks a turbulent past behind an ever-shifting performance. His relationship with Pierrot is one of the game's central dynamics.
list.routeTip: Select the red balloon in Day 1. Use bold, playful responses during tent encounters.

list.name: Jester
list.description: Jester exists between the other performers, neither fully loyal nor fully antagonistic. His route explores the ethics of entertainment and what it means to make others laugh.
list.routeTip: Jester's route unlocks in Day 2. Respond with humor but avoid direct confrontation.

list.name: Ticket Taker
list.description: The first character you meet. The Ticket Taker controls who enters and who leaves, and has watched everything at this circus for far longer than the others realize.
list.routeTip: Engage directly with every question the Ticket Taker asks. His route requires persistence.

list.name: Doctor
list.description: The Doctor's route is the most recently expanded and contains some of the game's darkest content. He is methodical, intimate, and deeply unsettling.
list.routeTip: The Doctor's content is largely contained to Day 2. Accept his examination scenes to progress his route.

walkthrough.title: The Freak Circus Walkthrough
walkthrough.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for every route, ending, and hidden scene.
walkthrough.spoilerText: This page contains major spoilers for all routes and endings. Play through at least Day 1 before consulting this guide.
walkthrough.day1P1: Day 1 establishes your affinity with each of the five characters through a series of carnival encounters. Your choices in the first 20 minutes determine which routes become available in Day 2.
walkthrough.day1P2: Key branching points in Day 1 include the entrance interaction with the Ticket Taker, the tent choice, and the evening meal conversation.
walkthrough.pierrotP1: Select introspective and empathetic options throughout Day 1. In the tent scene, follow the white cloak. During Day 2, choose understanding over resistance to unlock Pierrot's Good Ending.
walkthrough.pierrotP2: See the full Pierrot route article in our blog.
walkthrough.harlequinP1: Interact with the red balloon during the Day 1 carnival opening. Use bold, playful responses in the main tent. Harlequin's route escalates quickly in Day 2, so embrace the chaos rather than resist it.
